descriptions.zh: 您可以通过OperateNode 操作指定的资源节点，包括 禁止调度/启动调度等 操作
descriptions.en: Use OperateNode to manage a specified resource node. Supported operations include disabling or enabling scheduling.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun paistudio operate-node --node-id lingjunxxxx-mgxxx-xxxx --resource-group-id rgaekzbrflewn6jjq --operation Cordon --operation-parameters example-string --api-version 2022-01-12 --region cn-hangzhou
